verdict.rationale: Bento documents a public OTLP ingestion endpoint: point an exporter at one endpoint with one auth header, even with no Bento package. It also ships SDK calls such as bento.track_ai. That makes trace ingestion programmatically drivable, but no documented management or query API for issues, signals or analytics appears, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Full control is documented only through the CLI, which belongs to a separate story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented REST/HTTP management API reference, OpenAPI spec, API auth/token docs for non-ingest operations, independent corroboration.
